mapper.delete: delete from account_user_applications where user_id = #{userId} and app_code = #{appCode}
mapper.select: select count(*) from account_user_applications where user_id = #{userId} and app_code = #{appCode} and status = 'enabled'

select a.app_code, a.name, a.entry_url, a.sso_callback_url, a.permission_iframe_url, a.notify_base_url, a.secret, a.default_tenant_code, a.status, a.secret_version, a.secret_state, a.protocol_capabilities, a.version as application_version, a.created_by, a.updated_by, a.created_at, a.updated_at from account_applications a join account_user_applications ua on ua.app_code = a.app_code where ua.user_id = #{userId} and ua.status = 'enabled' order by a.app_code

select ua.user_id, ua.app_code, ua.desired_status, ua.version, 'pending_application_adaptation' as integration_status, null as sync_command_id, ua.updated_at from account_user_applications ua where ua.user_id = #{userId} order by ua.app_code

select ua.user_id, ua.app_code, ua.desired_status, ua.version, 'pending_application_adaptation' as integration_status, null as sync_command_id, ua.updated_at from account_user_applications ua where ua.user_id = #{userId} and ua.app_code = #{appCode}
mapper.update: update account_user_applications set status = #{desiredStatus}, desired_status = #{desiredStatus}, version = version + 1, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_at = current_timestamp, deauthorized_at = case when #{desiredStatus} = 'disabled' then current_timestamp else null end where user_id = #{userId} and app_code = #{appCode} and version = #{expectedVersion}
